title: Locked confirmatory test of the validation-selected grounded generator
researchQuestion: Does validation-selected GLM-5.2 retain grounded answer quality, citation reliability, abstention, and operational reliability on the 48-case confirmatory retrieval output?
hypothesis: GLM-5.2 will complete every evidence-bearing case without truncation, invalid citation labels, or provider mismatch and will retain the frozen human-quality guardrails.

selectionEvidence.judgeEligibility: disabled: neither calibrated judge satisfied the frozen calibration rule

lockedInputs.reasonForTwentyFiveCalls: All 24 answerable cases and the single retrieval false positive carry evidence; the remaining 23 negatives use the frozen deterministic no-evidence response.

generationControls.noEvidencePolicy: deterministic abstention without a provider call

executionPolicy: Commit this protocol and the integrity-checking runner before one logical execution. A cache-preserving recovery may retry only recorded technical failures and must retain completed outputs.

humanConfirmation.manualSelectionRule: Review every case for which the generator was invoked: all 24 answerable cases plus the one unanswerable retrieval false positive.
humanConfirmation.automaticAdjudicationRule: Count each no-evidence deterministic abstention as a correct abstention after verifying that the frozen response exactly matches the prompt policy; no semantic model output exists to score.
humanConfirmation.primaryMetric: mean normalized grounded answer quality over the 24 answerable cases
humanConfirmation.decisionRule: Final generation confirmation requires the primary minimum and every guardrail across all 48 cases. Human scores cover all 25 model-generated answers; the 23 deterministic no-evidence responses are incorporated by the frozen automatic rule.
humanConfirmation.procedureAmendment: The manual workload was reduced after generation but before semantic review. No answer, evidence packet, case label, metric threshold, or model output was changed or inspected to select favorable cases.

humanReview.worksheetIntegrity: All 25 case identities, questions, evidence packets, and substantive answers match the frozen worksheet. Browser export removed one line-ending space from one candidate answer; no semantic content changed.
humanReview.decision: Confirm GLM-5.2 BaseTen FP8 on the 48-case generation test. All 25 model-generated answers were manually reviewed, the 23 deterministic no-evidence responses were incorporated by the frozen automatic rule, and every human and operational guardrail passed.
humanReview.limitation: Single thesis-author review; inter-rater reliability is not estimated.

limitations: The final human review has one thesis-author reviewer and does not estimate inter-rater reliability.
The 900-token budget preserves the selected GLM comparison configuration.
One unanswerable case reaches the generator because retrieval supplied adjacent PostgreSQL evidence; this intentionally tests end-to-end semantic abstention.
The confirmatory retrieval run did not pass all preregistered ranking guardrails, so generation quality must be reported separately from retrieval success.
